global_summary: This educational video from the University of Wyoming Extension, hosted by Jeff Edwards, provides a practical guide to identifying and managing wasp nests in greenhouses and wooden structures. The host demonstrates nest location, examines the hexagonal comb architecture, shows safe removal techniques using specialized tools, and reviews commercial pest control products for effective greenhouse maintenance.

The expert weights reflect the primary focus areas: entomology (nest biology and behavior), greenhouse management (structural inspection and environment control), demonstration clarity (hands-on tool usage and physical samples), and brand context (institutional extension messaging).
